entries.question_note: Greater government action to solve problems is coded liberal; this is a general policy orientation, not a specific intervention. Response categories are mapped explicitly to −1 through +1. Unknown, skipped and not-asked answers are excluded. Annual values average available wave estimates equally; repeated panelists are not independent samples.
entries.weight: wave-specific weight_genpop; equal weight per observed wave within year
